(Currently amended) 1. A method comprising: receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations; automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are specifically tailored for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations.

(Currently amended) 2. The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts with unique filing system configurations.

A method comprising: receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a specific data record for generating a proof of claim; automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are specifically suited for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations.

(Currently amended) 7. The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having unique filing system configurations.
